//: The clearest gap found while researching this: search engines answer 'libfaketime for Windows' with a plain 'it does not run there', and stop. This page answers the question that was actually being asked - how do I do this on Windows - and maps the flags across so somebody arriving from Linux does not have to guess.
//honesty: Every statement about libfaketime comes from its own README. It already does several of the things this tool does, acceleration among them, and the page says so.

en.title: libfaketime for Windows - the closest equivalent
en.description: libfaketime needs LD_PRELOAD, which Windows does not have. Here is what replaces it, with the FAKETIME flags mapped one by one onto their Windows equivalents.

pl.title: libfaketime na Windows - najbliższy odpowiednik
pl.description: libfaketime potrzebuje LD_PRELOAD, którego Windows nie ma. Oto co go zastępuje, razem z flagami FAKETIME przełożonymi po kolei na windowsowe odpowiedniki.
